title: E-commerce
description: Adapt reviews to online shops and marketplaces that sell goods, services or digital content to consumers in the EU.
context: Ask the legal owner which countries the shop sells to: EU consumer directives apply through national law, and each country can add rules. This sector preselects the online-consumer-sales pattern.
Record whether the product is a merchant's own shop or a marketplace where third-party traders sell, since DSA Art. 30 and Art. 6a of Directive 2011/83/EU bind marketplaces only.
Leave card numbers to the payment service provider, which applies strong customer authentication under Directive (EU) 2015/2366 Art. 97; card data security needs its own review.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2015/2366 on payment services in the internal market (PSD2)
